products.name: Exchange Online → Gmail Migration (Mail, Calendar, Contacts) — Commercial
products.short_description: Migrate Exchange Online mailboxes to Gmail — mail, calendar, contacts — with the right tooling, coexistence/mail-flow, and per-user validation, pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move mailboxes to Gmail cleanly, with calendars and contacts intact

Email is the highest-visibility, highest-risk part of a Google move. This solution migrates Exchange Online mailboxes to Gmail — mail, calendar, and contacts — with the right tooling pattern, mail-flow/coexistence during transition, and per-user validation, so nothing is lost and users land smoothly, executed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Exchange-to-Gmail migration model (data types, tooling patterns, coexistence/mail routing, cutover) and the deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (source M365/Exchange access, Google tenant/licensing, DNS/mail-flow control, a migration tool, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps to configure the migration, run a named pilot batch, validate mail/calendar/contacts, manage coexistence and DNS/MX cutover, then expand by wave.
  • 5 supporting scripts — mailbox/estate discovery, per-user migration validation, a migration coverage/exception report, safe remediation of failed items, and a wave target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (migrated, validated, mail flows) plus Best Practices for cutover and coexistence.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every mailbox on Gmail with calendars and contacts intact — coexistence managed and cutover clean — proven on a pilot before you scale.

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
